checks.detail: Release executable must exist before desktop E2E can run.
tauri-driver is required for real Tauri WebDriver E2E.
Microsoft Edge WebDriver is required for Windows Tauri/WebView2 desktop automation.
Latest Tauri desktop E2E verifier evidence must be present and passed.

checks.detail: ContaPro sidecar workspace must exist.
Sidecar regulatory gate must be green before using it for real signing.
Sidecar evidence ledger must be green before using it for real signing.
CUMPLEFACTURA_ENABLE_REAL_XADES_SIDECAR must be enabled explicitly.
SIDECAR_ENABLE_REAL_XADES_ENDPOINTS must be enabled explicitly.
Shared HMAC secret must be provided by environment, never by prompt or file.
CUMPLEFACTURA_EXTERNAL_CERT_REF must use vault://certs/<id>.
SIDECAR_CERT_VAULT_DIR must point to a mounted local vault directory.
Vault must contain <id>.p12 or <id>.pfx for the certificate ref.
Certificate password must be supplied by SIDECAR_CERT_PASSWORD_<ID> or SIDECAR_CERT_PASSWORD.

secret_policy: Vault paths and certificate refs are redacted in evidence.
This audit performs no network call and no certificate parsing.
ContaPro sidecar import reads redacted local evidence only.
limits: Blocked is an expected safe status until real cert/vault/flags/evidence exist.
This audit proves readiness state only; it is not XAdES signing, AEAT transmission, CSV retrieval or homologation.
External acceptance is considered ready only when the manifest verifier records accepted AEAT_VERIFACTU evidence.
Imported SII/TicketBAI/FACe status is evidence visibility only; CumpleFactura still requires explicit flags/HMAC/vault before sidecar calls.
